title: The Amazing Spider-Man
keyStatus: First appearance of the Punisher (Frank Castle). First appearance of the Jackal.
notes: First appearance of the Punisher (Frank Castle) and the Jackal (Miles Warren). Bronze Age mega-key. Cover by Gil Kane, interior art by Ross Andru. The Punisher has become one of Marvel's most iconic anti-heroes, spawning multiple solo series, films, and TV shows. One of the most valuable Bronze Age Marvel books.
gradeCandidateReason: Grading is highly recommended for this major Bronze Age key to certify authenticity and maximize resale value, as the graded premium easily covers the grading costs.
